attacks.name: Size-Changing Smack Down
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, this character may transform into |*Wasp (Tiny)|. If it transforms, it drops all Civilian objective tokens it is holding before transforming.

superPowers.name: Change Size
superPowers.body: This character drops all Civilian objective tokens it is holding, then transforms into |*Wasp (Tiny)|. The |*Change Size| superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Pym Discs
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Pym Particle Control
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an enemy attack or would suffer a collision, it may use this superpower. This character drops all Civilian objective tokens it is holding then transforms into |*Wasp (Tiny)| before the attack or collision continues.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on both forms.
Size-Changing Smack Down, Tiny Superhero and Change Size now specify that only Civilian objective tokens are affected or restricted instead of all objective tokens.
